roleTitle: Accenture Song Life Group Account Supervisor

job.sourceChannel: user-provided job description; verified on Accenture Careers
job.location: Multiple United States locations, including Raleigh, NC
job.rawJd:
We Are:

Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for clients through sustained customer relevance. Its capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration.

You Are:

Song Life, part of Accenture Song, is seeking a Group Account Supervisor who serves as the internal leader of the brand and builds and maintains positive client relationships with a focus on achieving client goals. This person motivates and inspires others through transparent expression of ideas, fosters collaboration within and across teams, creates an environment that reinforces productive team relationships, opens growth opportunities for team members, encourages personal responsibility, and is sought out for coaching and mentoring. As an active member of the senior management team, this person helps advance the agency's mission and business by identifying opportunities and turning them into realities.

The Work:

- Serve as the internal leader of a brand, building and maintaining positive client relationships with a focus on client goals.
- Maintain client contact, understand client needs, communicate those needs to the internal team, and stay ahead of business opportunities or significant changes in the client's business.
- Lead the development and presentation of agency recommendations, points of view, and strategic initiatives, and actively promote agency offerings to clients.
- Partner closely with creative and integrated producer partners to manage day-to-day workflow.
- Maintain complete working knowledge of the assigned disease segment, products, and target audiences.
- Work with strategy partners to develop creative briefs and strategic plans.
- Contribute to tactical brainstorming.
- Provide accurate and timely product forecasts and manage quarterly reconciliations and billing.
- Work with the integrated producer to build statements of work.
- Develop and help manage career growth plans for junior account team members and instill confidence in the team.
- Travel may be required based on business and client needs.

Required qualification:
- At least five years of account or client-services experience within healthcare or pharmaceutical advertising.

Bonus qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
- Experience managing or mentoring others.
- Ability to manage deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Ability to elevate thinking and work.

The role requires authorization to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship. Accenture lists Raleigh, North Carolina among the available locations and expects the posting to remain open until October 24, 2026.
